Describe the application invariant, fault schedule and independent source of truth. Include a safe control, a violating control and an example where the evidence is inconclusive. Explain how a new contract would preserve existing v1 suites.

Who supplies the terminal attempt identity? Describe how the producer detects replica lag, records committed history and marks partial exports. List the effort needed for a second project to adopt the contract.
